content_sections.heading: Aliah University Visiting Faculty Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Aliah University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Aliah University Visiting Faculty Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Visiting Faculty: PG in Arabic/ Bengali / English, NET/ SET / GATE in any one of the above, Must have done a course on/ have had a paper on Translation studies, Spoken and written knowledge of Arabic and English and/ or Bengali and English, Knowledge of AI aided Machine Translation

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Per class basis with a ceiling per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Aliah University Visiting Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Aliah University for hiring temporary academic staff in Kolkata, West Bengal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position available under this notification is Visiting Faculty for Academic Knowledge Translation in Indian Languages.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Visiting Faculty position under Advertisement Number AU/Apptt.-18/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is entirely through a Walk-in Interview scheduled to be held on 13 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PG degree in Arabic, Bengali, or English with NET, SET, or GATE, along with a course or paper on Translation studies.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The interview will take place at the Board Room, 1st Floor, Aliah University (Park Circus Campus), 17, Gorachand Road, Kolkata-700 014.

faq.question: Q7. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at the interview venue by 11:00 am on 13 October 2026, with the interview starting at 12 noon.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for the Visiting Faculty?
faq.answer: The remuneration is structured on a per class basis with a specific monthly ceiling amount as per university guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. What documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to bring an application on plain paper with a detailed bio-data, a passport size photograph, and original along with self-attested photocopies of all testimonials.
